title: Luis López Méndez (London) to Simón Bolívar, 29 Jan 1819: 15 cipher words read from context by a partial table, read in part

documents.shelfmark: AGN Colombia, Sección Archivo Anexo, Grupo I, Historia, HISTORIA.SAA-I.17,25,D.24, ff. 226-228 (cipher on ff. 227v-228r)

plaintext.source: No decipherment over or beside the cipher words; the unit holds no key and no clear copy.

transcription.source: AGN Colombia DataViva, record 66b0cd4f151c9d47762a2382, gallery index 11 (f. 227v) and 12 (f. 228r), 1684 x 1999 px
transcription.notes: Second reader, blind, on 3x crops: all 70 letters agree; 2-3 of 42 digits undecided, about 3 of 70 symbols (4%), none changing a letter value. Rechecked at 4-7x: the 3 on the first i of i3 l e4 l is clear; the first m on f. 228r is m1 (the correction); the stroke over the last t of t1 l e4 t stays open.

system.summary: Letters with a digit 1-7 written above: letter + digit, and each bare letter, behave as single fixed symbols in this 70-sign sample (e1 = b, e2 = f, e3 = l, e4 = r, e5 = t, e6 = v, e7 = y).
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts 20 symbols with a value and the unvalued t with an extra stroke. homophones unknown: none is needed for the 14 read words, but 'Maracaibo' would need one (a written t, where a = l elsewhere). nulls unknown: 70 signs are too few to say. key_order: within each base letter the plain values rise with the digit (e: b f l r t v y; i: d p; m: c z; o: h o; t: m s). That is an observation on this small sample. Commas separate the cipher words.

prior_solution.where: The catalogue's vetting of 28 Oct 2026 (research/latam_vetting/1523_sample.txt) gave a first context reading, with 'cinco meses'. Otherwise none found: not on DECODE or cryptiana, no hit in 15 O'Leary volumes on archive.org, one web search of 2 Nov 2026. Bákula 1949, the Archivo del Libertador and Mondolfi's biography were not reached, so prior art is open.

conditions.human_role: WAINUT set the task (catalogue 1523) and the rules; the AI agents fetched the images, transcribed, built the table, read and checked. No target-specific human intervention, and no person has checked the reading against the images.
tools: solve.py (table, decryption, checks and control; standard library)
models: AI language-model agents (WAINUT); a vision-capable language model for the transcription

solution.what: Images of ff. 227r-228r fetched from the DataViva public API at 1684 x 1999 px, one request at a time.
All cipher words transcribed from the images: 15 words, 70 signs, 42 with a digit.

Table built from the clear context and the vetting's first reading: 20 symbols cover 69 signs, 0 conflicts in both directions. The table comes from the assumed plaintext, so this tests consistency only. 'cinco meses' corrected to 'cinco veces'.

Second reader, blind, on 3x crops: all 70 letters agree; about 3 of 70 symbols (4%) undecided, all digits. Own script: 0 conflicts. Its shuffle test: 76 of 20,000 without conflict. One search found no source for the jailings. It found the status word and the key claim overstated and 'Maracaibo' a proposal.

Must-fix pass on the images at 4-7x: first m on f. 228r is m1; the 3 on the first i of i3 l e4 l is clear; the last t of t1 l e4 t has an extra stroke, left open. Line numbers recounted: l. 17-18, 23 and 27 on f. 227v.

Plain words swapped among cipher words of equal length, 14 words, 20,000 trials: 62 without conflict, all 62 the true assignment. A mild test. The earlier 'held-out' test is withdrawn: its two words use only symbols already seen.
Within each base letter the plain values rise with the digit (e: b f l r t v y). Not assumed in building the table; supports e6 = v. Not checked by the second reader.
14 of 15 words read as sense, in sentences with the clear text. 'Maracaibo' kept as a guess: its fourth sign is written t, while a = l in all eleven other places.

One web search in Spanish found no edition or decipherment; one search found no source for an imprisonment of López Méndez in London in 1818-19. The rift with MacGregor over recruiting was found. Not reached: Bákula 1949, Archivo del Libertador, Mondolfi.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Nearest category only: a partial table guided by the clear text around the cipher words, fitting the 15 words without conflict. It is not a recovered key.
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcription.txt and decryption.txt: 69 of 70 signs have a value; 61 of 70 signs are in the 14 words that read as sense. By words 14 of 15 (read_share 0.933).

texts.label: The 15 cipher words, ff. 227v-228r
texts.summary: Pressing Bolívar for funds, López Méndez says in cipher that he has been jailed five times and released on bail; no other source for this was found. Mac Gregor, he says, has done untold harm to the cause; he joined an expedition of his, for [?Maracaibo], and left it. Mac Gregor is now trying to go to Santafé.
texts.note: Only the bold words are cipher; the clear text is there to give sentences. Editorial repairs are marked {E1}-{E4} in reading.md.

outcome.notes: Corrects the catalogue's vetting reading 'cinco meses': the third and fifth signs are m1 and t3, two symbols, so 'meses' does not fit. The jailings rest on the cipher alone. Prior art is open, so first_break is not set.
